A1.justification: Both PDFs describe CNS-Bench and contain readable main text, equations, figures, tables, supplementary analyses, and dataset datasheets. The supplementary content can be reliably matched across renumbering and layout changes.

before.justification: Sections 4–5 report original filtering and classifier robustness experiments. The appendices also report fine-tuning results, ablations, and a human study.

after.justification: The same original filtering, classifier robustness, fine-tuning, ablation, and human-study results remain in the main paper and relabeled supplementary sections.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.4 retain the same textual inversion, class-specific LoRA sliders, activation during later diffusion steps, and four-component OOC filtering procedure. No algorithm, architecture, or objective changes are identified.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same ImageNet class coverage and 14 nuisance shifts, OOD-CV weather evaluation, ImageNet-C corruption analyses, ImageNet-R fine-tuning evaluation, and human studies. Renumbered supplementary sections introduce no new coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the CLIP filtering comparison, classifier comparisons in Tables 3–5, and diffusion-versus-discriminative comparison in Figure 14. No evaluated comparison method is added or removed.

E3.justification: The main benchmark retains 100 classes evaluated with 1,000-way classifiers, 192,168 images, the same shift scales, and the same metrics. Supplementary generation, fine-tuning, ablation, and OOD-CV protocols are relocated without substantive revisions.

E4.justification: The class-count ablation in Figure 25, text-based shift case studies in Figure 26, and ID/OOD accuracy analyses in Figures 20–24 are retained unchanged. Their supplementary headings and locations change, but the questions tested and evidence remain the same.

E5.justification: Both retain one-sigma intervals in Figures 7 and 11, regression p-values in Figure 21, and the human study's one-sigma margin of error. Seed information and uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Matched tables, plots, and result passages retain their values and findings. For example, both report filtering accuracy of 0.88 versus 0.65 for CLIP in Table 2b, and ImageNet-R accuracy of 27.34 without versus 37.57 with fine-tuning in Table 6.

T1.justification: Equations 1–6 retain the same mathematical content, including the LoRA objective, failure-point definition, similarity measures, and relative corruption-error formula. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about continuous nuisance shifts, improved OOC filtering, the large-scale classifier study, severity-dependent rankings, and failure-point analysis.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning ID/OOD accuracy, OOD-CV confounding, and differences between model families are retained. Section 6 and the datasheet preserve the same limitations concerning CLIP biases, residual confounders, and synthetic-versus-real distribution differences.

D1.justification: Implementation details move from v1 Section A.7 to v2 Section G without changing the SD2.0 pipeline, DDIM settings, guidance scale, hardware, or compute budgets. Code/data access statements and datasheet release and licensing information are also unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning remain unchanged. Reference back-page numbers change with supplementary pagination, but no prior work or substantive novelty claim is added or removed.

P1.justification: Affiliations are expanded, the introduction receives a brief wording edit, and the acknowledgment corrects the funding body's English name. Appendix A.1–A.12 becomes supplementary Sections A–L, and the datasheet moves from B to M, with updated cross-references; substantive prose and ordering are largely retained.

P2.justification: V2 adds a supplementary title, restarts supplementary pagination, and reflows text and existing displays. Examples include moving Table 8 and Figure 30 between columns and placing Table 9's caption above the table. Figure and table content remains unchanged.

improvement.justification: V2 mainly repackages the supplement and updates affiliations and minor wording. It preserves the methods, empirical evidence, interpretations, limitations, and reproducibility information. The limited organizational and layout adjustments do not materially improve or impair the paper's overall clarity or scientific support.
